lines.text: The psalmist calls the servants of the LORD to praise His name, which is to be blessed now and forevermore.
From where the sun rises to where it sets, the name of the LORD is praised.
The LORD is exalted over all the nations, and His glory is above the earth.
He raises the poor from the dust and seats them with the servants of the king.
He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother to her children.
